items.answer: The diagram illustrates the process by which used glass bottles are recycled into new ones. First, used bottles are collected from homes and public bins, after which they are transported to a recycling plant. On arrival, the glass is sorted by colour into clear, green, and brown, and it is then washed thoroughly so that labels and dirt are removed. Next, the clean glass is crushed into small fragments known as cullet. Once this stage is complete, the cullet is melted in a furnace at an extremely high temperature until it becomes liquid. The molten glass is then moulded into the shape of new bottles. Finally, the finished bottles are filled, labelled, and sent to shops, where the cycle can begin again.
accepted: The diagram illustrates the process by which used glass bottles are recycled into new ones. First, used bottles are collected from homes and public bins, after which they are transported to a recycling plant. On arrival, the glass is sorted by colour into clear, green, and brown, and it is then washed thoroughly so that labels and dirt are removed. Next, the clean glass is crushed into small fragments known as cullet. Once this stage is complete, the cullet is melted in a furnace at an extremely high temperature until it becomes liquid. The molten glass is then moulded into the shape of new bottles. Finally, the finished bottles are filled, labelled, and sent to shops, where the cycle can begin again.
items.reason: Setiap langkah ditulis dalam passive present simple (are collected, is sorted, is melted, are sent) karena pelakunya tidak relevan; urutannya disatukan oleh kata penanda urutan (first, then, next, once, finally); dan tense-nya tetap konsisten dari awal sampai akhir.

g07_conditionals.title: 7. Conditionals, Hedging & Hypothetical Reasoning
g07_conditionals.group: Modul 2 · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures & Range Booster
blocks: Empat conditional sebagai skala kenyataan, pilihan antara first dan second yang paling penting di Task 2, satu aturan yang menghilangkan sebagian besar kesalahan conditional, dan perangkat hedging untuk kehati-hatian akademis.

Conditional memungkinkan Anda berargumen tentang kemungkinan: apa yang terjadi jika sesuatu benar, apa yang akan terjadi seandainya hal itu benar, dan apa yang akan terjadi seandainya masa lalu berbeda. Inilah grammar untuk konsekuensi dan hipotesis, dan sangat penting di Task 2, di mana hampir setiap argument sebenarnya adalah conditional yang tersamar: jika pemerintah melakukan X, maka Y akan terjadi. Di samping conditional ada hedging, yaitu bahasa kehati-hatian (may, tend to, it is likely that), yang membuat klaim Anda tidak terdengar mutlak dan membuat tulisan Anda terdengar terukur dan akademis.

Setiap conditional memiliki if-clause (syaratnya) dan main clause (hasilnya). Urutannya bebas; jika if-clause datang lebih dulu, beri comma sesudahnya. If demand rises, prices increase. = Prices increase if demand rises. Empat conditional standar hanya berbeda dalam pola tense di kedua clause itu, dan masing-masing menyatakan tingkat kenyataan yang berbeda.
If you heat ice, it melts.
kemungkinan nyata di masa depan yang besar peluangnya
If taxes rise, consumption will fall.
masa kini/masa depan yang tidak nyata atau kecil kemungkinannya
If I were rich, I would fund schools.
masa lalu yang tidak nyata (penyesalan, melihat ke belakang)
If they had invested, the crisis would have been avoided.

Bacalah tabel ini sebagai skala kenyataan: zero selalu benar, first memang mungkin terjadi, second hanya dibayangkan atau kecil kemungkinannya, third sekarang mustahil karena momennya sudah lewat. Memilih yang tepat berarti memilih seberapa nyata klaim Anda ingin terdengar.
Catatan tentang “were” dalam second conditional: bahasa Inggris formal memakai were untuk semua subject (“If the government were to act …”), dan ini pilihan yang lebih aman di Writing.
7.3 First versus second: pilihan yang paling penting di Task 2
Sebagian besar kesalahan dan pilihan conditional Anda bermuara pada first versus second, jadi latihlah pasangan ini.
Pakai first conditional untuk usulan nyata yang menurut Anda benar-benar mungkin terjadi. If the government invests in public transport, congestion will decrease.
Pakai second conditional untuk hal hipotetis atau saran yang Anda sajikan sebagai sesuatu yang dibayangkan. If every citizen planted a tree, the city would be greener.
If the government will raise taxes, spending falls.
If the government raises taxes, spending will fall.
If-clause dalam first conditional memakai present simple, tidak pernah “will.”
If I would be in charge, I would ban cars.
If I were in charge, I would ban cars.
If-clause dalam second conditional memakai past simple / “were,” tidak pernah “would.”
Satu aturan yang menghilangkan sebagian besar kesalahan conditional

Jangan pernah menaruh “will” atau “would” di dalam if-clause. “Will” dan “would” hanya ada di result clause. Pertahankan if-clause dalam tense simple/past, dan Anda menghilangkan kesalahan conditional yang paling umum dalam satu langkah.
7.4 Mixed conditional dan inverted conditional (sentuhan Band 8+)
Dua teknik lanjutan ini menambah range jika cocok secara alami:
Mixed conditional: syarat di masa lalu dengan hasil di masa kini. If they had planned better (masa lalu), the city would not be so congested now (masa kini).

Inverted conditional (formal, tanpa “if”): Had the government acted sooner, the crisis would have been avoided. = If the government had acted sooner … (Anda akan mempelajari inversion secara lengkap di Bab 8.)
Pakai struktur ini sekali saja, dengan tepat, untuk memberi efek. Mixed conditional yang dipaksakan lebih buruk daripada conditional standar yang rapi.

Hedging berarti melunakkan sebuah klaim agar tidak menjadi pernyataan mutlak. Tulisan Band 5 penuh dengan pernyataan berlebihan (always, never, everyone, will definitely). Tulisan Band 8 membatasi klaimnya, dan anehnya justru membuat klaim itu terdengar lebih meyakinkan dan lebih akademis. Ini salah satu cara tercepat untuk membuat nada tulisan Anda lebih matang.
tend to, be likely to, appear to, seem to
often, generally, in many cases, to some extent, relatively
it is likely that, it appears that, there is a tendency for
many, some, a significant number of, the majority of
Junk food always causes obesity and will destroy public health.
Excessive consumption of junk food may contribute to obesity and could place a strain on public health.
“always causes” dan “will destroy” terlalu berlebihan; “may contribute” dan “could place a strain” lebih terukur.

Hedging bukan kelemahan atau ketidakjelasan. Hedging adalah ketepatan tentang seberapa yakin Anda. “Immigration boosts the economy” adalah klaim yang tidak bisa Anda buktikan sepenuhnya; “Immigration can boost the economy” adalah klaim yang bisa Anda pertahankan.

Ada dua kelompok kesalahan yang paling sering muncul. Yang pertama adalah tense yang "bocor" dalam conditional (menaruh will/would di dalam if-clause). Yang kedua adalah kebiasaan menulis pernyataan mutlak yang menyapu rata, yang sebagian berasal dari gaya tegas yang umum dalam essay berbahasa Bangla.

Jenis kesalahan 1 · “will/would” di dalam if-clause.
✗ If the price will increase, demand will fall. / If governments would ban plastic, pollution would drop.
✓ If the price increases, demand will fall. / If governments banned plastic, pollution would drop.

Jenis kesalahan 2 · Pernyataan mutlak tanpa batasan.
✗ Technology always improves our lives. / Every student prefers online classes.
✓ Technology generally improves our lives. / Many students appear to prefer online classes.
Conditional dan hedging bersama-sama menentukan kematangan Task 2

Task 2 menghargai dua hal yang diberikan bab ini. Conditional memberi Anda struktur untuk berargumen tentang konsekuensi (“if this policy is adopted, then …”), yang menjadi tulang punggung body paragraph. Hedging memberi Anda nada agar argument itu terdengar masuk akal, bukan dogmatis. Tulisan yang memadukan second conditional yang tepat dengan hedging yang ditempatkan dengan baik jelas terbaca sebagai Band 7 ke atas, karena menunjukkan grammatical range sekaligus kendali retoris.

Skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (first conditional): If governments subsidise clean energy, the transition away from fossil fuels is likely to accelerate.
Task 2 (second + hedge): If education were entirely free, access might improve, though the burden on public finances would probably be considerable.
Speaking Part 3: It tends to depend on the context, but on the whole I'd say technology has made communication easier.
Akhir Bab 7, sekaligus akhir Modul 2. Selanjutnya Modul 3 (Band 9.0 Masterclass), Bab 8.

g07_conditionals_practice.title: 7. Practice · Conditionals, Hedging & Hypothetical Reasoning
g07_conditionals_practice.group: Modul 2 · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures & Range Booster
blocks: Empat conditional berada pada sebuah skala kenyataan, dari yang selalu benar sampai yang sudah tidak mungkin lagi. Memilih yang tepat berarti memilih seberapa nyata klaim Anda ingin terdengar -- jika salah pilih, kemungkinan yang nyata terbaca seperti khayalan belaka, atau sebaliknya.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Pilihan conditional menunjukkan seberapa yakin Anda pada sebuah klaim, dan ini sangat penting dalam argumentasi Task 2.
**Zero** -- kebenaran umum / fakta ilmiah: If you heat ice, it melts.
**First** -- kemungkinan nyata di masa depan yang besar peluangnya: If taxes rise, consumption will fall.
**Second** -- dibayangkan atau kecil kemungkinannya: masa kini/masa depan yang hipotetis.
**Third** -- sekarang mustahil, karena momennya sudah lewat.
Bacalah skalanya secara berurutan: zero selalu benar, first memang mungkin terjadi, second hanya dibayangkan, third mustahil.
Bahasa Inggris formal memakai **were** untuk semua subject dalam second conditional -- If the government were to act... -- dan ini pilihan yang lebih aman di Writing.

blocks.title: Exercise 7.1 · Menulis Ulang Conditional
blocks.instructions: Ubah verb di dalam tanda kurung ke bentuk yang benar sesuai conditional yang diminta, atau tulis ulang sesuai instruksi. Perhatikan if-clause: tidak boleh ada “will” atau “would” di sana.

items.prompt: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ______ (boil).
items.answer: boils
accepted: boils
items.reason: Zero conditional: kebenaran umum, present simple di kedua clause.

items.prompt: If the government reduces tuition fees, more students ______ (enrol).
items.answer: will enrol
accepted: will enrol
items.reason: First conditional: kemungkinan nyata di masa depan.

items.prompt: If I ______ (be) the mayor, I would ban private cars in the centre.
items.answer: were
accepted: were

items.prompt: If they had listened to the experts, the disaster ______ (avoid).
items.answer: would have been avoided
accepted: would have been avoided
items.reason: Third conditional: past perfect + would have + past participle (passive).

items.prompt: If the price of oil rises, transport costs ______ (increase).
items.answer: will increase
accepted: will increase

items.prompt: If people recycled more, landfill sites ______ (fill) up less quickly.
items.answer: would fill
accepted: would fill

items.prompt: If the company had invested in training, its staff ______ (be) more productive today. (mixed)
items.answer: would be
accepted: would be
items.reason: Mixed conditional: syarat di masa lalu, hasil di masa kini.

items.prompt: Ice melts if the temperature ______ (rise) above zero.
items.answer: rises
accepted: rises

items.prompt: If more people ______ (use) public transport, the air would be cleaner.
items.answer: used
accepted: used
items.reason: Second conditional: past simple di dalam if-clause.

items.prompt: If the trend continues, sea levels ______ (rise) by a metre this century.
items.answer: will rise
accepted: will rise

items.prompt: If governments ______ (act) sooner, many species would not have become extinct.
items.answer: had acted
accepted: had acted
items.reason: Third conditional: past perfect di dalam if-clause.

items.prompt: If I were you, I ______ (choose) the science course.
items.answer: would choose
accepted: would choose

items.prompt: Rewrite as an inverted conditional: If the authorities had responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
items.answer: Had the authorities responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
accepted: Had the authorities responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
items.reason: Inverted third conditional: hapus “if,” letakkan “had” di depan.

items.prompt: If children ______ (not / get) enough sleep, their concentration suffers.
items.answer: do not get
accepted: do not get
don't get

items.prompt: If renewable energy became cheaper, developing countries ______ (adopt) it faster.
items.answer: would adopt
accepted: would adopt

blocks: Tulisan Band 5 penuh dengan pernyataan mutlak -- always, never, everyone. Tulisan Band 8 melunakkan klaimnya dengan modal dan verb kecenderungan, dan anehnya ini membuat klaim terdengar lebih meyakinkan, bukan kurang percaya diri.

**Mengapa ini penting:** Hedging adalah salah satu peningkatan tercepat dan paling mudah dipelajari untuk naik dari tulisan Band 6-7 ke tulisan Band 8 -- ini perangkat yang bisa dipelajari, bukan bakat.

Hedging melunakkan sebuah klaim agar tidak menjadi pernyataan mutlak. "Immigration boosts the economy" adalah klaim yang tidak bisa Anda buktikan sepenuhnya; "Immigration can boost the economy" adalah klaim yang bisa Anda pertahankan.
**Modal verb untuk kemungkinan:** may, might, could, can.
**Verb untuk kecenderungan:** tend to, be likely to, appear to, seem to.
**Adverb untuk frekuensi/tingkat:** often, generally, in many cases, to some extent, relatively.
**Pola impersonal:** it is often argued that, it could be said that.
Hedging bukan kelemahan atau ketidakjelasan -- hedging adalah ketepatan tentang seberapa yakin Anda sebenarnya.

blocks.title: Exercise 7.2 · Drill Meningkatkan Hedging
blocks.instructions: Setiap sentence terlalu berlebihan. Tulis ulang dengan hedging yang tepat agar terdengar terukur dan akademis.

items.prompt: Fast food always causes serious health problems.
items.answer: Fast food can cause serious health problems.
accepted: Fast food can cause serious health problems.
Fast food may cause serious health problems.
Fast food often causes serious health problems.

items.prompt: Everyone agrees that social media is harmful.
items.answer: Many people argue that social media can be harmful.
accepted: Many people argue that social media can be harmful.
It is often argued that social media can be harmful.
items.reason: Ganti pernyataan universal “everyone … is” dengan klaim yang memakai hedging.

items.prompt: Immigration will definitely boost the economy.
items.answer: Immigration is likely to boost the economy.
accepted: Immigration is likely to boost the economy.
Immigration can boost the economy.

items.prompt: Students who study abroad always become more independent.
items.answer: Students who study abroad tend to become more independent.
accepted: Students who study abroad tend to become more independent.

items.prompt: Technology never has any negative effects.
items.answer: Technology does not always have negative effects.
accepted: Technology does not always have negative effects.
Technology rarely has serious negative effects.

items.prompt: All young people prefer texting to phone calls.
items.answer: The majority of young people appear to prefer texting to phone calls.
accepted: The majority of young people appear to prefer texting to phone calls.
Many young people seem to prefer texting to phone calls.

items.prompt: Higher taxes will completely solve the problem of pollution.
items.answer: Higher taxes may help to reduce pollution.
accepted: Higher taxes may help to reduce pollution.
Higher taxes could help to reduce pollution.

items.prompt: Every developed country has excellent public services.
items.answer: Most developed countries tend to have good public services.
accepted: Most developed countries tend to have good public services.

items.prompt: Working from home is always more productive than working in an office.
items.answer: Working from home can be more productive than working in an office.
accepted: Working from home can be more productive than working in an office.

items.prompt: Tourism completely destroys local culture.
items.answer: Tourism may, to some extent, erode local culture.
accepted: Tourism may, to some extent, erode local culture.
Tourism can erode local culture to some extent.

g08_inversion.title: 8. Inversion, Cleft Sentence & Advanced Emphasis
g08_inversion.group: Modul 3 · Band 9.0 Masterclass (Ketepatan Bahasa Tingkat Lanjut)
blocks: Struktur penekanan tingkat tinggi yang jarang dipakai: inversion dengan negative adverbial yang dibangun memakai question word order, it-cleft dan what-cleft, serta disiplin untuk memakai satu saja dengan tepat, bukan banyak.

Selamat datang di masterclass Band 9. Mulai dari sini, semuanya tentang ketepatan dan kecanggihan, bukan perbaikan kesalahan. Struktur dalam modul ini adalah struktur yang muncul secara alami dalam tulisan pengguna bahasa Inggris yang sangat mahir: jarang dipakai, memberi penekanan, dan harus digunakan secukupnya dan dengan tepat. Satu inversion yang ditempatkan dengan baik menunjukkan penguasaan; tiga inversion yang dipaksakan menunjukkan kandidat yang hanya menghafal trik. Kualitas dan kendali, bukan jumlah, adalah inti pesan Modul 3.

Inversion berarti membalik urutan normal subject-verb sehingga verb (atau auxiliary) datang sebelum subject, pola yang biasanya hanya Anda lihat dalam pertanyaan. Dalam pernyataan, kita melakukannya dengan sengaja untuk memberi penekanan, biasanya dengan memindahkan ungkapan negatif atau pembatas ke depan sentence. Jika ungkapan seperti itu berada di depan, subject dan auxiliary bertukar tempat. Normal: The government has rarely intervened. / Inverted: Rarely has the government intervened.

Mekanismenya persis sama dengan mekanisme pertanyaan: letakkan negative adverbial di depan, lalu pakai question word order (auxiliary + subject). Jika tidak ada auxiliary, tambahkan do / does / did, sama seperti dalam pertanyaan. Normal: The minister realised the scale of the problem only later. / Inverted: Only later did the minister realise the scale of the problem.
Inversion terpicu ketika salah satu negative adverbial atau adverbial pembatas ini dipindahkan ke depan. Hafalkan set-nya; inilah tiket masuknya.
Never before has the country faced such a crisis.
Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.
Not only does it cut costs, but it also saves time.
No sooner had the policy begun than it was criticised.
Hardly had the scheme started when problems emerged.
Only after / Only when / Only by
Only by investing heavily can the goal be achieved.
Under no circumstances should this be ignored.
Little did they know how costly it would be.
Not until 2015 did the figures begin to recover.
Trigger inversion yang negatif dan membatasi
8.3 Cara membangun inverted sentence, langkah demi langkah
Mulailah dengan sentence biasa: The government has seldom acted so quickly.
Pilih trigger-nya dan pindahkan ke depan: Seldom …
Terapkan question word order (auxiliary sebelum subject): Seldom has the government …
Lengkapi sentence-nya: Seldom has the government acted so quickly.

Jika sentence aslinya tidak memiliki auxiliary, tambahkan do / does / did dan kembalikan main verb ke base form, persis seperti saat membuat pertanyaan. The committee only later understood the risk. → Only later did the committee understand the risk. (bukan “understood”)
8.4 Cleft sentence: memecah kalimat untuk penekanan

Cleft sentence (dari kata “cleave,” yaitu membelah) membagi satu ide menjadi dua clause untuk menyorot satu unsur. Ini alat penekanan yang lebih lembut dan lebih umum daripada inversion, dan sangat alami baik di Writing maupun Speaking. Ada dua pola utama.

Struktur: It + is/was + unsur yang ditekankan + that/who + sisanya. Biasa: The lack of funding caused the failure. / Cleft: It was the lack of funding that caused the failure. (sorotan pada penyebabnya)
Struktur: What + clause + is/was + unsur yang ditekankan. Biasa: We need better public transport. / Cleft: What we need is better public transport. (sorotan pada solusinya)
What-cleft sangat berguna untuk membuka sebuah poin dengan tegas dalam essay atau jawaban Speaking: What many governments overlook is the long-term cost of inaction.
Jangan merusak agreement atau memakainya berlebihan
Bahaya struktur ini bukan pada konsepnya, tetapi pada pelaksanaannya. Ada dua kegagalan yang sering terulang.

Kegagalan 1 · Lupa memakai question word order setelah trigger. Subject dan auxiliary harus bertukar tempat; jika urutannya tetap normal, inversion-nya batal.
✗ Never before the country has faced such a crisis. / Rarely politicians admit their mistakes.
✓ Never before has the country faced such a crisis. / Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.

Kegagalan 2 · Pemakaian berlebihan. Memakai beberapa inversion atau cleft dalam satu jawaban membuat tulisan terdengar teatrikal dan tidak alami. Targetnya adalah satu contoh yang tepat, ditempatkan pada momen yang benar-benar perlu ditekankan.
✗ (tiga inversion dalam satu paragraph)
✓ (satu inversion yang ditempatkan dengan baik, sisanya dengan urutan normal)
Satu inversion bisa mengangkat seluruh tulisan

Inversion dan cleft bukan grammar sehari-hari; keduanya adalah sentuhan istimewa yang menandai band tertinggi. Examiner yang ingin memberi Band 8 atau 9 untuk Grammatical Range and Accuracy mencari persis hal ini: bukti bahwa kandidat bisa menghasilkan bentuk yang jarang dan kompleks secara tepat dan alami. Cara strategisnya adalah satu inversion atau cleft yang ditempatkan pada sentence terpenting dalam essay atau jawaban Speaking Part 3, yaitu poin yang paling ingin Anda tekankan. Jika dilakukan sekali dengan rapi, ini sinyal positif yang kuat. Jika berlebihan, justru merugikan Anda.

Skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (inversion): Not only does renewable energy reduce emissions, but it also creates long-term employment.
Task 2 (what-cleft): What is often forgotten in this debate is the cost of doing nothing.
Speaking Part 3 (it-cleft): It was really the support of my family that made the biggest difference.
Akhir Bab 8. Selanjutnya Bab 9 (Nominalisation & Academic Density).

g08_inversion_practice.title: 8. Practice · Inversion, Cleft Sentence & Advanced Emphasis
g08_inversion_practice.group: Modul 3 · Band 9.0 Masterclass (Ketepatan Bahasa Tingkat Lanjut)
blocks: Inversion terpicu ketika negative adverbial atau adverbial pembatas pindah ke depan sentence -- never, rarely, not only. Pelajari set trigger ini sebagai daftar tetap, dan pola auxiliary-sebelum-subject akan menjadi otomatis.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Inversion yang benar adalah salah satu tanda Band 9 paling jelas yang dicari examiner -- dan salah satu yang paling mudah salah jika dicoba dengan ceroboh.
Inversion terpicu ketika salah satu negative adverbial atau adverbial pembatas ini pindah ke depan:
**Never / Never before** -- Never before has the country faced such a crisis.
**Rarely / Seldom** -- Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.
**Not only... (but also)** -- Not only does it cut costs, but it also saves time.
Hafalkan dulu set trigger-nya. Begitu trigger berada di depan, subject dan auxiliary verb bertukar tempat persis seperti dalam pertanyaan -- itulah seluruh mekanismenya.

blocks.title: Exercise 8.1 · Mengubah ke Bentuk Inversion
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang setiap sentence dengan diawali ungkapan negatif atau pembatas, lalu terapkan question word order. Jika sebuah sentence sudah di-inversion tetapi salah, perbaiki.

items.prompt: The government has never faced such a challenge before.
items.answer: Never before has the government faced such a challenge.
accepted: Never before has the government faced such a challenge.
items.reason: Letakkan “never before” di depan, lalu auxiliary + subject.

items.prompt: Politicians rarely admit that they were wrong.
items.answer: Rarely do politicians admit that they were wrong.
accepted: Rarely do politicians admit that they were wrong.
items.reason: Tidak ada auxiliary, jadi tambahkan “do” dan pakai base verb.

items.prompt: The scheme had scarcely started when problems appeared.
items.answer: Scarcely had the scheme started when problems appeared.
accepted: Scarcely had the scheme started when problems appeared.
items.reason: Letakkan “scarcely” di depan, balik menjadi “had the scheme.”

items.prompt: We understood the true cost only after the project ended.
items.answer: Only after the project ended did we understand the true cost.
accepted: Only after the project ended did we understand the true cost.
items.reason: “Only after …” memicu inversion di main clause; tambahkan “did.”

items.prompt: This document should not be shared under any circumstances.
items.answer: Under no circumstances should this document be shared.
accepted: Under no circumstances should this document be shared.
items.reason: Letakkan “under no circumstances” di depan, balik menjadi “should this document.”

items.prompt: The policy not only reduced costs but also improved safety.
items.answer: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved safety.
accepted: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved safety.
items.reason: Letakkan “not only” di depan, tambahkan “did” + base verb “reduce.”

items.prompt: They little realised how much the plan would cost.
items.answer: Little did they realise how much the plan would cost.
accepted: Little did they realise how much the plan would cost.
items.reason: Letakkan “little” di depan, tambahkan “did” + base verb.

items.prompt: The figures did not begin to recover until 2016.
items.answer: Not until 2016 did the figures begin to recover.
accepted: Not until 2016 did the figures begin to recover.
items.reason: Letakkan “not until 2016” di depan, balik dengan “did.”

items.prompt: The company had no sooner launched the product than it was copied.
items.answer: No sooner had the company launched the product than it was copied.
accepted: No sooner had the company launched the product than it was copied.
items.reason: Letakkan “no sooner” di depan, balik menjadi “had the company.”

items.prompt: The goal can be achieved only by working together.
items.answer: Only by working together can the goal be achieved.
accepted: Only by working together can the goal be achieved.
items.reason: Letakkan “only by working together” di depan, balik menjadi “can the goal.”

items.prompt: It is the lack of investment that has caused the decline. (identify: which cleft, and what is emphasised?)
items.answer: It-cleft; it emphasises the cause, “the lack of investment.”
accepted: It-cleft; it emphasises the cause, “the lack of investment.”
It-cleft, emphasising the lack of investment.
It-cleft
items.reason: It-cleft menyorot unsur yang berada di antara “it is/was” dan “that.”

items.prompt: Rewrite emphasising the solution with a what-cleft: We need a long-term plan.
items.answer: What we need is a long-term plan.
accepted: What we need is a long-term plan.
items.reason: What-cleft: “What + clause + is + unsur yang ditekankan.”

items.prompt: Seldom a government reverses such a popular policy. (fix the inversion)
items.answer: Seldom does a government reverse such a popular policy.
accepted: Seldom does a government reverse such a popular policy.

items.prompt: Rewrite with an it-cleft emphasising “her determination”: Her determination impressed the panel.
items.answer: It was her determination that impressed the panel.
accepted: It was her determination that impressed the panel.

items.prompt: Never before people had access to so much information. (fix the inversion)
items.answer: Never before had people had access to so much information.
accepted: Never before had people had access to so much information.
items.reason: Balik menjadi “had people had” setelah “never before.”

blocks: Cleft sentence memecah satu ide menjadi dua clause untuk menyorot satu unsur. Ini lebih lembut daripada inversion dan jauh lebih alami di Writing maupun Speaking -- dua pola sudah mencakup hampir semua kegunaannya.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Cleft sentence adalah cara yang alami dan berisiko rendah untuk menambah penekanan tanpa aturan grammar ketat yang dituntut inversion.
Struktur: **It + is/was + unsur yang ditekankan + that/who + sisanya.**
Biasa: The lack of funding caused the failure. → Cleft: It was the lack of funding that caused the failure. (sorotan pada penyebabnya)
Struktur: **What + clause + is/was + unsur yang ditekankan.**
Biasa: We need better public transport. → Cleft: What we need is better public transport. (sorotan pada solusinya)
What-cleft sangat berguna untuk membuka sebuah poin dengan tegas: What many governments overlook is the long-term cost of inaction.

blocks.title: Exercise 8.2 · Membangun Cleft Sentence
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang setiap sentence dalam bentuk cleft yang diminta (it-cleft atau what-cleft), dengan menyorot unsur yang disebutkan.

items.prompt: Emphasise the cause with an it-cleft: Poor planning led to the delay.
items.answer: It was poor planning that led to the delay.
accepted: It was poor planning that led to the delay.

items.prompt: Emphasise the solution with a what-cleft: The city needs more green spaces.
items.answer: What the city needs is more green spaces.
accepted: What the city needs is more green spaces.

items.prompt: Emphasise the time with an it-cleft: The crisis began in 2008.
items.answer: It was in 2008 that the crisis began.
accepted: It was in 2008 that the crisis began.

items.prompt: Emphasise what people overlook with a what-cleft: People overlook the long-term costs.
items.answer: What people overlook is the long-term costs.
accepted: What people overlook is the long-term costs.

items.prompt: Emphasise the person with an it-cleft: My mentor changed my career.
items.answer: It was my mentor who changed my career.
accepted: It was my mentor who changed my career.

items.prompt: Emphasise the real issue with a what-cleft: The real issue is a lack of funding.
items.answer: What matters most is the lack of funding.
accepted: What matters most is the lack of funding.
What the real issue is is a lack of funding.
What is really at stake is the lack of funding.

items.prompt: Emphasise the place with an it-cleft: The decision was made in Parliament.
items.answer: It was in Parliament that the decision was made.
accepted: It was in Parliament that the decision was made.

items.prompt: Emphasise the action needed with a what-cleft: Governments must act now.
items.answer: What governments must do now is act.
accepted: What governments must do now is act.
What governments need to do now is act.

items.prompt: Emphasise the factor with an it-cleft: Education drives development.
items.answer: It is education that drives development.
accepted: It is education that drives development.

items.prompt: Emphasise the priority with a what-cleft: We should prioritise public health.
items.answer: What we should prioritise is public health.
accepted: What we should prioritise is public health.

g09_nominalisation.title: 9. Nominalisation & Kepadatan Akademik
g09_nominalisation.group: Modul 3 · Band 9.0 Masterclass (Ketepatan Bahasa Tingkat Lanjut)
blocks: Perubahan verb/adjective menjadi noun yang menjadi ciri register akademik, tiga cara menyusun ulang kalimat untuk Task 2, nominalisation sebagai cohesion device, dan disiplin untuk tidak berlebihan memakai nominalisation sampai tulisan menjadi kabur.

Nominalisation adalah proses mengubah verb atau adjective menjadi noun, dan inilah ciri paling khas dari bahasa Inggris akademik yang formal. Dalam percakapan sehari-hari orang berkata “the government decided to act, and this reduced pollution,” sedangkan dalam tulisan akademik ditulis “the government's decision to act led to a reduction in pollution.” Informasinya sama persis; yang berubah adalah register-nya. Dengan nominalisation, Anda bisa memuat lebih banyak makna dalam lebih sedikit kata, menghubungkan ide dengan lancar, dan memakai nada yang impersonal dan berfokus pada konsep, yang oleh examiner dikaitkan dengan band tertinggi.

Nominalisation mengubah kata yang menyatakan tindakan (verb) atau kata yang menyatakan sifat (adjective) menjadi kata benda (noun). Begitu sebuah ide menjadi noun, ide itu bisa menjadi subject kalimat, dan inilah yang membuat tulisan akademik terasa abstrak dan berpusat pada konsep.
Family verb→noun dan adjective→noun yang umum
Perhatikan bagaimana ide yang sama berpindah dari bentuk berbasis verb (personal, bertele-tele) ke bentuk berbasis noun (impersonal, padat).
Because the company expanded quickly, it became difficult to manage.
The company's rapid expansion led to management difficulties.
“expanded” menjadi “expansion,” “difficult to manage” menjadi “management difficulties”; kalimatnya lebih pendek dan lebih formal.
The government decided to invest in schools, and this improved literacy.
The government's decision to invest in schools improved literacy.
Seluruh clause pertama diringkas menjadi satu noun phrase yang bisa berfungsi sebagai subject.
Mekanismenya adalah tiga langkah yang bisa Anda pakai kapan saja: temukan tindakan atau sifatnya; ubah menjadi noun; lalu susun ulang kalimat di sekitar noun itu sebagai subject atau object.
9.3 Tiga cara menyusun ulang kalimat untuk Task 2
Ubah clause “because” menjadi noun subject. “Because pollution increased, health worsened” → “The increase in pollution worsened public health.”
Jadikan seluruh peristiwa sebagai subject kalimat berikutnya, agar sambungannya lancar. “The factory closed. This caused unemployment.” → “The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.”
Ganti “X is important / X is able to” dengan sebuah noun. “It is important to reduce waste” → “The reduction of waste is a priority.”

Cara kedua ini (event → subject) juga merupakan cohesion device: menyebut ide sebelumnya sebagai noun (“this closure,” “such growth,” “this development”) adalah cara yang canggih untuk menghubungkan paragraph tanpa connector murahan seperti “moreover.”
Jangan berlebihan memakai nominalisation sampai tulisan menjadi kabur

Nominalisation memang ampuh, tetapi risikonya nyata: kalimat yang dijejali abstract noun menjadi berat, kaku, dan sulit dibaca. Keterampilan Band 9 adalah keseimbangan, yaitu memakai nominalisation untuk menaikkan register sambil tetap menjaga kalimat tetap jelas. Ada dua masalah yang sering muncul.

Masalah 1 · Rangkaian noun. Merangkai beberapa abstract noun dengan “of” menghasilkan tumpukan yang tidak bisa dibaca.
✗ The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
✓ Reducing energy consumption is essential.

Masalah 2 · Pelakunya hilang sama sekali. Kadang pembaca perlu tahu siapa yang bertindak; nominalisation total bisa menyembunyikan siapa yang bertanggung jawab tanpa alasan yang baik.
✗ A decision was reached and an implementation followed.
✓ The committee decided to act and then implemented the plan.

Nominalisation adalah salah satu ciri paling jelas yang membedakan script Band 6.5 (yang terbaca seperti ucapan yang hati-hati) dari script Band 8 (yang terbaca seperti tulisan akademik). Dua manfaatnya langsung sesuai dengan marking criteria: nominalisation menaikkan Lexical Resource, karena memaksa Anda memilih kata yang tepat dan formal, dan menaikkan Coherence and Cohesion, karena menyebut ide sebelumnya sebagai noun menghubungkan kalimat dengan elegan. Petunjuknya: pakailah dengan sengaja di topic sentence dan transisi Anda, di mana kepadatan dan formalitas paling penting, sambil menjaga kalimat penjelasan Anda tetap jelas.

Skill yang terbantu: Writing
Topic sentence Task 2: The rapid urbanisation of developing nations has placed enormous pressure on public infrastructure.
Cohesion di Task 2 (event → subject): This expansion, however, has come at a significant environmental cost.
Ringkasan Task 1: The overall growth in exports was matched by a comparable rise in imports.
Akhir Bab 9, sekaligus akhir Modul 3. Selanjutnya Modul 4 (The Full Workbook), Bab 10: editing essay secara utuh dan pemolesan transcript speaking, lalu answer key lengkap di Bab 11.

g09_nominalisation_practice.title: 9. Practice · Nominalisation & Kepadatan Akademik
g09_nominalisation_practice.group: Modul 3 · Band 9.0 Masterclass (Ketepatan Bahasa Tingkat Lanjut)
blocks: Nominalisation mengubah verb atau adjective menjadi noun -- decide menjadi decision, difficult menjadi difficulty. Begitu sebuah ide menjadi noun, ide itu bisa menjadi subject kalimat, dan justru inilah yang membuat tulisan akademik terasa abstrak dan berpusat pada konsep.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Nominalisation adalah satu kebiasaan grammar yang paling berperan dalam membedakan bahasa Inggris percakapan dari bahasa Inggris akademik.

Nominalisation mengubah kata yang menyatakan tindakan (verb) atau kata yang menyatakan sifat (adjective) menjadi kata benda (noun). Begitu sebuah ide menjadi noun, ide itu bisa menjadi **subject** kalimat.

Melatih family ini ke dua arah -- mengenali bentuk verb-nya dan langsung membentuk noun-nya -- itulah yang membuat nominalisation siap dipakai di bawah tekanan ujian, bukan sekadar sesuatu yang hanya Anda kenali saat membaca.

blocks.title: Exercise 9.1 · Latihan Nominalisation
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang setiap kalimat dengan register yang lebih akademik dengan menjadikan kata dalam kurung sebagai noun (nominalise), lalu jadikan noun itu subject atau object. Satu soal meminta Anda menyederhanakan rangkaian kata yang terlalu banyak nominalisation.

items.prompt: The company expanded rapidly, and this created management problems. (nominalise “expanded”)
items.answer: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.
accepted: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.

items.prompt: Because the population grew, the demand for housing rose. (nominalise “grew”)
items.answer: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
accepted: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
Population growth raised the demand for housing.

items.prompt: The factory closed, which caused widespread unemployment. (nominalise “closed”)
items.answer: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.
accepted: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.

items.prompt: It is important to reduce waste. (nominalise “reduce” and “important”)
items.answer: The reduction of waste is a priority.
accepted: The reduction of waste is a priority.
Waste reduction is important.

items.prompt: The government decided to invest in railways, and this improved transport. (nominalise “decided”)
items.answer: The government's decision to invest in railways improved transport.
accepted: The government's decision to invest in railways improved transport.

items.prompt: Because energy is consumed at a high rate, emissions have risen. (nominalise “consumed”)
items.answer: The high consumption of energy has raised emissions.
accepted: The high consumption of energy has raised emissions.
High energy consumption has raised emissions.

items.prompt: The team failed to plan properly, which led to delays. (nominalise “failed”)
items.answer: The team's failure to plan properly led to delays.
accepted: The team's failure to plan properly led to delays.

items.prompt: Many species have become extinct, and this worries scientists. (nominalise “become extinct”)
items.answer: The extinction of many species worries scientists.
accepted: The extinction of many species worries scientists.

items.prompt: The city developed quickly, and this attracted investors. (nominalise “developed”)
items.answer: The city's rapid development attracted investors.
accepted: The city's rapid development attracted investors.

items.prompt: Prices increased sharply, which reduced consumer spending. (nominalise “increased”)
items.answer: The sharp increase in prices reduced consumer spending.
accepted: The sharp increase in prices reduced consumer spending.

items.prompt: People are more aware of climate change, and this has changed behaviour. (nominalise “aware”)
items.answer: Growing awareness of climate change has changed behaviour.
accepted: Growing awareness of climate change has changed behaviour.

items.prompt: The two countries cooperated, and trade improved. (nominalise “cooperated”)
items.answer: Cooperation between the two countries improved trade.
accepted: Cooperation between the two countries improved trade.

items.prompt: Simplify the noun string: The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
items.answer: Reducing energy consumption is essential.
accepted: Reducing energy consumption is essential.
Cutting energy consumption is essential.
items.reason: Uraikan tumpukan “of” itu kembali menjadi bentuk yang jelas.

items.prompt: The scientists analysed the data carefully, and this revealed a pattern. (nominalise “analysed”)
items.answer: The scientists' careful analysis of the data revealed a pattern.
accepted: The scientists' careful analysis of the data revealed a pattern.

items.prompt: Because the roads were poor, transport costs were high. (nominalise “poor”)
items.answer: The poor condition of the roads raised transport costs.
accepted: The poor condition of the roads raised transport costs.
The poor state of the roads raised transport costs.
items.reason: “poor (roads)” diubah menjadi “the poor condition of the roads”.

blocks.title: Exercise 9.2 · Menyusun Ulang dan Menjernihkan Kalimat
blocks.instructions: Ditambahkan untuk melengkapi Bab 9 (setiap bab lain punya dua exercise). Soal 1–6: tulis ulang setiap kalimat dengan cara menyusun ulang yang ada dalam kurung dari 9.3. Soal 7–10: setiap kalimat terlalu banyak nominalisation; tulis ulang agar tetap formal tetapi mudah dibaca, seperti di kotak “Jangan berlebihan memakai nominalisation sampai tulisan menjadi kabur”.

items.prompt: Because traffic increased, air quality in the city declined. (move 1: “because” clause → noun subject)
items.answer: The increase in traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
accepted: The increase in traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
The increase in traffic led to a decline in the city's air quality.
Increased traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
items.reason: Clause “because” menjadi noun subject “the increase in traffic”; “declined” menjadi “a decline in”.

items.prompt: Because the region became poorer, crime rose sharply. (move 1)
items.answer: The region's growing poverty led to a sharp rise in crime.
accepted: The region's growing poverty led to a sharp rise in crime.
Growing poverty in the region led to a sharp rise in crime.
The increase in poverty in the region caused a sharp rise in crime.
items.reason: “became poorer” → “poverty” (adjective poor → noun poverty, seperti di table 9.1); “rose” → “a rise in”.

items.prompt: The government banned plastic bags. This reduced litter on beaches. (move 2: event → subject of the next sentence)
items.answer: The government's ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
accepted: The government's ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
The ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
items.reason: Kalimat pertama diringkas menjadi noun phrase “the ban on plastic bags”, yang kemudian menjadi subject.

items.prompt: Many young people migrated to cities. This weakened rural communities. (move 2)
items.answer: The migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
accepted: The migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
The large-scale migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
items.reason: “migrated” → “the migration of”; seluruh peristiwa itu kini menjadi subject.

items.prompt: It is important to protect endangered species. (move 3: “It is important to …” → noun)
items.answer: The protection of endangered species is a priority.
accepted: The protection of endangered species is a priority.
The protection of endangered species is essential.
Protecting endangered species is a priority.
items.reason: “to protect” → “the protection of”, dan kata “important” yang kurang jelas diganti dengan noun complement yang tepat (“a priority”).

items.prompt: Many students are not able to afford university fees. (move 3: “be able to” → noun)
items.answer: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
accepted: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
The inability of many students to afford university fees is a concern.
Many students' inability to afford university fees is a concern.
items.reason: “are not able to” → “lack the ability to” / “inability” (able → ability, seperti di table 9.1).

items.prompt: The implementation of the improvement of the quality of the provision of education is required.
items.answer: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
accepted: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
The quality of education needs to be improved.
Educational quality must be improved.
items.reason: Rangkaian noun dengan empat frasa “of” tidak bisa dibaca; pertahankan satu ide kuat (quality of education) dan pakai bentuk verb untuk tindakannya.

items.prompt: The reduction of the consumption of water by the population of the city is a necessity.
items.answer: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
accepted: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
Reducing water consumption in the city is necessary.
The city needs to reduce its water consumption.
items.reason: Ubah salah satu noun yang bertumpuk kembali menjadi verb (reduction → reduce) dan ganti “of the population of the city” dengan bentuk possessive.

items.prompt: There was an expansion in the utilisation of the internet by the elderly for the purpose of communication.
items.answer: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
accepted: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
Internet use among older people for communication has expanded.
More elderly people now use the internet to communicate.
items.reason: “utilisation” adalah noun yang dibesar-besarkan untuk “use”, dan “for the purpose of communication” hanya mengaburkan “to communicate”; formal tidak sama dengan bertele-tele.

items.prompt: The occurrence of the failure of the system was a consequence of the lack of maintenance.
items.answer: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
accepted: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
The system's failure was caused by a lack of maintenance.
A lack of maintenance caused the system to fail.
items.reason: “The occurrence of the failure” tidak menambah apa pun; pakai paling banyak satu nominalisation (failure atau lack) dan biarkan verb yang jelas membawa makna sebabnya.

g10_editing.title: 10. Editing Essay Lengkap & Pemolesan Transcript Speaking
blocks: Self-editing terpadu dalam kondisi ujian: checklist enam pass, lima essay utuh yang penuh kesalahan untuk diperbaiki (dari yang paling banyak salahnya sampai yang paling sedikit), dan lima jawaban speaking untuk dinaikkan satu band tanpa terdengar seperti hafalan.

Di setiap bab sejauh ini, Anda memperbaiki satu jenis kesalahan dalam satu waktu, dan sudah tahu sebelumnya apa yang harus dicari. Ujian sungguhan tidak seperti itu. Dalam essay sungguhan, semua aturan dari Modul 1 sampai 3 berlaku sekaligus, kesalahannya bercampur dan tidak diberi label, dan Anda harus menemukan kesalahan Anda sendiri di bawah tekanan waktu tanpa kunci jawaban di samping Anda. Modul terakhir ini melatih tepat keterampilan itu: self-editing terpadu. Anda akan memperbaiki essay utuh yang mengandung semua jenis kesalahan, lalu meningkatkan jawaban speaking sungguhan dari aman-tapi-dasar menjadi terkontrol-dan-fleksibel.

Setiap tugas editing di bawah ini adalah satu essay atau paragraph utuh yang penuh kesalahan, ditulis kira-kira di level Band 5.5 sampai 6.0, dan sengaja diisi jenis-jenis kesalahan yang sudah Anda pelajari. Bekerjalah dengan urutan yang disiplin, bukan membaca secara acak untuk mencari “hal-hal yang terlihat salah.”
Agreement pass: periksa setiap verb terhadap subject-nya yang sebenarnya (Bab 1).
Tense pass: periksa apakah setiap time frame benar dan konsisten (Bab 2).
Article pass: periksa a / an / the / zero di depan setiap singular noun (Bab 3).
Preposition pass: periksa dependent preposition dan data preposition (Bab 4).
Structure pass: periksa apakah ada fragment, run-on, dan comma splice; pastikan ada variasi complex sentence (Bab 5).
Range pass: apakah ada setidaknya satu passive, satu conditional, dan sedikit hedging di tempat yang sesuai (Bab 6, 7)? Apakah ada satu high-band structure yang akurat (Bab 8, 9)?

Lakukan pass terpisah untuk setiap item. Mencoba menangkap semuanya dalam sekali baca adalah penyebab kesalahan lolos; saat proofreading, pemeriksa yang fokus pada satu hal selalu lebih unggul daripada yang memeriksa semuanya sekaligus.

Ada lima essay editing di exercise bab ini, diurutkan dari yang paling banyak kesalahannya (Essay 1) sampai yang paling sedikit (Essay 5). Masing-masing punya versi model yang sudah dikoreksi dan rincian kesalahan per kategori, sehingga Anda bisa melihat pass mana dari enam pass Anda yang akan menangkap setiap kesalahan. Kerjakan secara berurutan; essay-essay berikutnya menganggap Anda sudah menguasai perbaikan pada essay sebelumnya.

Anda tidak sedang menulis ulang essay itu dengan gaya Anda sendiri. Anda hanya membuat koreksi minimum yang dibutuhkan untuk ketepatan dan range, sambil mempertahankan makna penulisnya. Itulah persis yang harus Anda lakukan pada script Anda sendiri di lima menit terakhir ujian.

Grammar juga dinilai di Speaking, dengan kriteria Grammatical Range and Accuracy yang sama, tetapi targetnya berbeda: di Speaking Anda butuh fleksibilitas yang terkontrol secara real time, bukan kepadatan tulisan. Lima soal speaking di exercise memberi Anda jawaban lisan sungguhan yang dasar-tapi-aman, dan meminta Anda menaikkannya satu band dengan menambahkan tepat teknik-teknik yang diajarkan kursus ini, tanpa membuatnya terdengar seperti hafalan.
Perangkat peningkatan untuk Speaking, diurutkan dari yang paling bernilai:
Perbaiki ketepatan dasar dulu: agreement, tense, dan article, karena kesalahan di sini paling banyak mengurangi nilai.
Tambahkan satu complex sentence: clause dengan because, although, atau which untuk menghubungkan dua ide.
Tambahkan kontras tense: berpindah antara past, present, dan future untuk menunjukkan range (“I used to … but now I … and I think I'll …”).
Tambahkan satu frasa hedging: “it depends,” “I'd say,” “on the whole,” “tend to.”
Jika mau, satu cleft yang alami untuk penekanan: “what I really enjoy is …”

Tujuannya adalah bahasa Inggris lisan yang akurat dan fleksibel, bukan paragraph hafalan. Satu complex sentence yang alami dan satu kontras tense dalam jawaban Part 2 akan lebih membantu nilai Anda daripada idiom yang dihafalkan.
Mengapa editing terpadu adalah keterampilan ujian yang sesungguhnya

Kedua writing task sebaiknya diakhiri dengan beberapa menit untuk editing, dan kandidat yang melakukan editing secara sistematis biasanya mendapat setengah band lebih tinggi di Grammatical Range and Accuracy dibanding yang tidak, karena kesalahan kecil yang sama (-s yang hilang, article yang terlewat, will di dalam if-clause) sangat umum sekaligus mudah ditangkap dengan pass yang terarah. Di Speaking, kemampuan melakukan self-correct dengan lancar (“the number of people were, sorry, was rising”) justru menjadi tanda positif bahwa Anda mampu mengontrol bahasa. Bab ini membangun kebiasaan yang mengubah semua yang sudah Anda pelajari menjadi nilai dalam kondisi ujian.

Skill yang terbantu: Writing, Speaking
Manfaat editing: Edit enam pass yang sistematis di lima menit terakhir biasanya menghilangkan sebagian besar kesalahan agreement, tense, dan article.
Self-correction di Speaking: “They has - sorry, they have - improved a lot recently.”
Lima essay editing dan lima soal pemolesan speaking ada di exercise bab ini. Bab 11 kemudian memberikan answer key lengkap, langkah demi langkah, untuk setiap exercise di buku ini.

g10_editing_practice.title: 10. Practice · Editing Essay Lengkap & Pemolesan Transcript Speaking
blocks: Mencoba menangkap setiap kesalahan grammar dalam sekali baca adalah penyebab kesalahan lolos. Jalankan pass terpisah yang fokus pada satu hal untuk setiap aturan -- agreement, lalu tense, lalu article, lalu preposition -- karena saat proofreading, pemeriksa yang fokus selalu lebih unggul daripada yang memeriksa semuanya sekaligus.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Checklist ini menyatukan semua bab sebelumnya menjadi satu rutinitas editing yang bisa diulang dan dijalankan pada essay apa pun sebelum Anda mengumpulkannya.
1. **Agreement pass** -- periksa setiap verb terhadap subject-nya yang sebenarnya (Bab 1).
2. **Tense pass** -- periksa apakah setiap time frame benar dan konsisten (Bab 2).
3. **Article pass** -- periksa a/an/the/zero di depan setiap singular noun (Bab 3).
4. **Preposition pass** -- periksa dependent preposition dan data preposition (Bab 4).

Lakukan **pass terpisah untuk setiap item**, jangan mencoba menangkap semuanya dalam sekali baca. Saat proofreading, pemeriksa yang fokus selalu lebih unggul -- pass yang fokus pada satu hal menangkap kesalahan yang sama sekali terlewat dalam pembacaan umum.

blocks.title: Exercise 10.1 · Editing Essay Lengkap
blocks.instructions: Lima essay yang penuh kesalahan, diurutkan dari yang paling banyak sampai yang paling sedikit kesalahannya. Jalankan checklist enam pass pada masing-masing dan tulis ulang dengan benar, sambil mempertahankan makna penulisnya. Essay 5 juga meminta Anda menambahkan satu high-band structure.

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 1 (heavily flawed). Correct every error, preserving the meaning. “In many country, the number of student who go abroad for study have increased in recent years. This trend have both advantage and disadvantage. On one hand, student who studies in foreign university gets access to better facility and they can learns new culture. On other hand, it is very expensive and many family cannot affords it. In my opinion, if government will provide more scholarship, this problem can be solved. According to me, the advantage is more than the disadvantage.”
items.answer: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
accepted: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Agreement: country→countries, student→students, have→has (the number bersifat singular), studies→study, gets→gain, learns→learn, affords→afford. Article: on the one hand, on the other hand, the government. Conditional: “if government will provide”→“if the government provided … could be solved” (tidak ada will di dalam if-clause). Register: “According to me”→“Overall / In my view”; “advantage is more than”→“advantages outweigh the disadvantages.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 2. Correct every error. “Nowadays, technology have changed the way we communicate. In the past, people was writing letters which take many days to arrive. But now, we can sends a message in a second. Although this is convenient, but it also have some negative effect. For example, many young people spends too much time on their phone and they forgets how to talk face to face. If this trend continue, our social skill will became weaker.”
items.answer: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
accepted: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
items.reason: Agreement: have→has, can sends→send, have→has, spends→spend, forgets→forget, skill→skills. Tense: “was writing”→“wrote” (kebiasaan di masa lalu), “take”→“took.” Structure: “Although … but” adalah connector ganda - hapus “but.” Conditional: “if … continue … will became”→“continues … will become” (base verb setelah will). Plural/article: effect→effects, phone→phones.

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 3. Correct every error. “Pollution is one of the most serious problem in the world today. The main cause of it are the vehicles and the factories. In big cities, the air quality have become very poor, and many people suffers from breathing disease. Government should took strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we do something about this issue.”
items.answer: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
accepted: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
items.reason: Agreement: problem→problems (setelah “one of the most”), cause … are→causes are, have become→has become (subject-nya “quality”), suffers→suffer, disease→diseases. Bentuk verb: “should took”→“should take.” Article: “the vehicles and the factories”→bentuk umum “vehicles and factories”; “Government”→“Governments.” Mixed conditional-nya sudah benar (“had acted … would not be … now”). “It is high time” diikuti past subjunctive: “we did,” bukan “we do.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 4 (lightly flawed). Correct every error. “There is many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offers more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, the access to good education and healthcare are better. However, urban life also have its drawbacks, such as pollution and high cost of living. Despite of these problems, the majority of people still prefers city life.”
items.answer: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
accepted: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
items.reason: Agreement: “There is many”→“There are many,” offers→offer, “access … are”→“access … is” (subject-nya “access,” singular), have→has, prefers→prefer (subject “majority of people” di sini diperlakukan sebagai plural). Preposition: “Despite of”→“Despite” (tanpa “of”). Article: “a high cost of living.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 5 (subtle errors + one range upgrade). Correct the errors, then add ONE high-band structure (an inversion, a cleft, or a nominalisation) where it fits. “Renewable energy has become more important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This is a positive development, but it is also expensive. Not only it reduces emissions, it also creates jobs. The transition will take time, but it is necessary.”
items.answer: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
accepted: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
items.reason: Teks dasarnya hampir akurat; perbaikan utamanya adalah inversion: “Not only it reduces”→“Not only does it reduce …, but it also creates” (urutan kata seperti pertanyaan setelah “not only” yang diletakkan di depan). Peningkatan opsional yang ditunjukkan: “increasingly important” untuk register, “This shift” sebagai subject hasil nominalisation yang menjaga cohesion, “the transition to clean energy” untuk kepadatan.

blocks: Speaking dinilai dengan kriteria Grammatical Range and Accuracy yang sama seperti Writing, tetapi targetnya berbeda: fleksibilitas yang terkontrol secara real time, bukan kepadatan tulisan. Perbaiki ketepatan dasar dulu, lalu tambahkan satu complex sentence dan satu kontras tense.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Kandidat sering terlalu banyak menyiapkan grammar untuk Writing dan kurang menyiapkan kriteria yang sama untuk Speaking, padahal tujuannya berbeda.
Perangkat peningkatan untuk Speaking, diurutkan dari yang paling bernilai
1. **Perbaiki ketepatan dasar dulu** -- agreement, tense, dan article, karena kesalahan di sini paling banyak mengurangi nilai.
2. **Tambahkan satu complex sentence** -- clause dengan because, although, atau which untuk menghubungkan dua ide.
3. **Tambahkan kontras tense** -- berpindah antara past, present, dan future untuk menunjukkan range: I used to..., but now I...

Bahasa Inggris lisan yang akurat dan fleksibel -- bukan paragraph hafalan. Satu complex sentence yang alami dan satu kontras tense dalam jawaban Part 2 akan lebih membantu nilai Anda daripada idiom yang dihafalkan.

blocks.title: Exercise 10.2 · Pemolesan Transcript Speaking
blocks.instructions: Lima jawaban lisan yang dasar-tapi-aman. Naikkan masing-masing satu band dengan memperbaiki ketepatan dasar dan menambahkan satu complex sentence, satu kontras tense, dan satu frasa hedging, tanpa membuatnya terdengar seperti hafalan.

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 1. Raise this Part 1 answer one band, keeping it natural. “Yes, I like reading. I read many book. My favourite is story book. I read every day because it is relaxing.”
items.answer: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
accepted: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
items.reason: Perbaiki: “many book”→“a lot of books,” “story book”→“fiction.” Tambahkan range: clause dengan because, frasa hedging (“I'd say”), dan penekanan mirip cleft (“it's the best way … to unwind”), ditambah peningkatan tense/register.

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 2. Raise this Part 1 answer one band. “I live in Dhaka. It is big city. There is many people. I like it because my family is here.”

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 4. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Yes, technology changed our life. Before, people did everything by hand. Now, machine do the work. I think it is good.”

g11_review.title: 11. Answer Key, Diagnostic Index & Rutinitas Ujian
blocks: Rujukan untuk memantapkan materi, bukan latihan baru: cara meninjau jawaban yang salah, diagnostic index berisi kesalahan yang paling sering terjadi beserta satu aturan yang memperbaiki masing-masing, peta lengkap semua bab, dan rutinitas self-edit sepuluh menit saat ujian.

Setiap exercise di kursus ini bisa diperiksa sendiri: saat Anda mengirim jawaban, platform menampilkan versi yang benar, alasan mengapa itu benar, dan catatan berbahasa Indonesia yang menjelaskan aturan dasarnya. Bab terakhir ini bukan kumpulan latihan baru. Bab ini adalah rujukan untuk memantapkan materi, tempat Anda kembali ketika sebuah kesalahan terus berulang, agar Anda bisa menemukan satu aturan yang memperbaiki seluruh kelompok kesalahan. Pakailah sebagai diagnostic index: kenali kesalahan yang terus Anda buat, lalu baca ulang aturannya dan bab asalnya.

Ketika jawaban Anda salah, jangan hanya membaca jawaban yang benar lalu lanjut. Luangkan tiga puluh detik untuk mendiagnosisnya, karena jenis kesalahan yang sama akan muncul lagi dalam tulisan Anda sendiri.
Baca model answer dan alasannya bersamaan, agar Anda melihat bagaimana aturannya bekerja, bukan hanya perbaikannya.
Sebutkan jenis kesalahannya: apakah itu masalah agreement, tense, article, preposition, structure, atau range?
Kembali ke bab sumber untuk jenis kesalahan itu (petanya ada di 11.3) dan baca ulang satu aturan yang mengaturnya.

Tulis dua kalimat baru buatan Anda sendiri yang menerapkan aturan itu dengan benar. Membentuk sendiri struktur itu, bukan sekadar mengenalinya, adalah yang memindahkannya ke dalam active grammar Anda.
11.2 Kesalahan yang paling sering terjadi, dan satu aturan yang memperbaiki masing-masing
Inilah kesalahan yang paling sering muncul dalam script kandidat Bangladesh. Jika Anda menguasai table singkat ini, Anda akan menghilangkan sebagian besar kesalahan yang terus berulang.
Verb mengikuti subject yang sebenarnya, bukan noun yang paling dekat.
Uncountable noun tidak memakai a/an dan tidak punya bentuk plural.
Benda yang hanya ada satu (unik) memakai ‘the’.
Tahun yang sudah selesai memakai past simple, bukan present perfect.
‘Since/for’ memakai perfect tense, bukan present continuous.
Preposition dari terjemahan langsung: discuss X; in my opinion.
Dependent clause tidak bisa berdiri sendiri (fragment).
Dua clause tidak cukup dihubungkan dengan comma saja (comma splice).
Tidak ada will/would di dalam if-clause.
Lunakkan klaim yang terlalu luas dengan hedging: may, tend to, generally.
Setelah negative yang diletakkan di depan, pakai urutan kata seperti pertanyaan.
Diagnostic index untuk kesalahan yang berulang
kesesuaian verb–subject; delapan kasus yang sulit
dua belas tense; past simple vs present perfect; simple vs continuous
preposition untuk waktu/tempat/data; dependent preposition; perbaikan kesalahan dari bahasa ibu (L1)
clause; adverbial clause dan relative clause; fragment/run-on/splice
passive di berbagai tense; impersonal frame; process writing
empat conditional; aturan if-clause; perangkat hedging
inversion setelah negative adverbial; it-cleft dan what-cleft
verb/adjective → noun; kepadatan akademik dan cohesion
self-edit enam pass; menaikkan jawaban lisan satu band
11.4 Rutinitas sepuluh menit terakhir saat ujian

Pada hari ujian, grammar yang sudah Anda bangun hanya akan berguna jika Anda menyisakan waktu untuk melakukan self-edit. Sisihkan beberapa menit terakhir di setiap writing task untuk tinjauan yang terarah, dengan menjalankan pass dari Bab 10 secara berurutan.
Task 1 (sisakan ~3 menit): periksa setiap tense terhadap time frame data; periksa data preposition (by, from, to, of); pastikan “the number of” dan “the proportion of” diikuti singular verb.

Task 2 (sisakan ~5 menit): jalankan pass agreement, article, dan preposition; pastikan tidak ada “will” di dalam if-clause; pastikan ada variasi complex sentence dan setidaknya satu high-band structure yang bersih.
Speaking (secara real time): jika Anda mendengar kesalahan agreement atau tense, lakukan self-correct dengan lancar lalu lanjutkan; self-correction yang rapi adalah tanda kontrol, bukan kelemahan.

Mengetahui sebuah aturan dan menerapkannya di bawah tekanan adalah dua keterampilan yang berbeda, dan jarak di antara keduanya hanya bisa ditutup dengan kebiasaan meninjau yang dijelaskan di bab ini. Kandidat yang mendiagnosis kesalahan yang terus mereka ulangi, kembali ke aturan yang mengaturnya, lalu membuat contoh baru yang benar, berkembang jauh lebih cepat daripada mereka yang hanya mengerjakan latihan sekali. Anggap setiap jawaban salah di kursus ini sebagai informasi tentang satu aturan mana yang perlu Anda tinjau lagi. Siklus itu, dari kesalahan ke aturan lalu ke kalimat baru, adalah yang mengubah belajar menjadi band yang lebih tinggi.

Skill yang terbantu: Writing, Speaking
Siklus review: Jawaban salah → sebutkan jenis kesalahannya → baca ulang aturannya → tulis dua kalimat benar buatan Anda sendiri.
Rutinitas ujian: Selalu sisihkan menit-menit terakhir untuk menjalankan enam pass editing secara berurutan.

Dengan ini kursus selesai. Kembalilah ke exercise bab mana pun untuk berlatih sampai bentuk yang benar terasa otomatis; platform akan terus memberi nilai dan menampilkan alasan serta catatan berbahasa Indonesia untuk setiap soal.
